artifacts.notes: Normalized transcription, not a facsimile or critical edition. Historical Latin wording is public domain in the United States; portal markup and translations have separate rights. Historical witness: Acta Sanctae Sedis 36 (1903–1904), pp. 530–532. Uncollated normalized web transcription; source wording and numbering retained apart from the explicitly recorded corrections and apparatus exclusions. Original printing closes with Cardinal A. Macchi, while the web witness uses PIUS PP. X; this signature difference is retained and disclosed, not a diplomatic equivalence. Publication is bounded by the identified volume's final year; its first issue date is unrecorded.
artifacts.rights_basis: Historical Latin wording identified in Acta Sanctae Sedis 36 (1903–1904), pp. 530–532, published by 1930. United States expired-term assessment under 17 U.S.C. 304/305; qualifying foreign restoration under 104A(a)(1)(B) only receives the remaining term. Under 103(b), this covers preexisting historical wording rather than modern creative additions. Vatican HTML, translations of later date, and scan/reprint wrappers have separate rights. See src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml.
